text_blocks.snippet: Class 4 impact-resistant shingles are the highest-rated asphalt roofing materials available, engineered with polymer-modified asphalt to withstand severe hail, heavy snow loads, and high winds common in Utah. They pass the strict UL 2218 impact test by resisting cracks when struck by a 2-inch steel ball dropped from 20 feet.
snippet_highlighted_words: the highest-rated asphalt roofing materials available, engineered with polymer-modified asphalt to withstand severe hail, heavy snow loads, and high winds common in Utah

list.snippet: Storm Durability: Resists damage from severe mountain hailstorms, wind-driven debris, and intense freeze-thaw cycles.
Insurance Discounts: Many major insurance providers operating in Utah offer annual premium discounts (often 5% to 25%) for installing a Class 4-rated roof.
Extended Lifespan: Better granule retention and rubberized flexibility mean fewer granule losses and a longer service life compared to standard 3-tab or architectural shingles.

Malarkey Vista / Legacy

: Frequently noted for rubberized polymer flexibility and high wind/impact performance. Most users on Reddit agree that Malarkey Vista
offers an exceptional balance of price and durability.
